note: Single source of truth for reviewed upstream Strata serve/server.py sources. Hashes are SHA-256 of the file with CRLF normalized to LF (legacy CRLF-byte hashes kept for 0.1.41). A reviewed hash is only a fast path: unknown sources are analysed structurally at import time (strata_observer.analyze_source) and observed or degraded per capability.

reviewed.review: Public run delegates to _run under a keep-awake finally block; event/done, request_stats and handler boundaries intact.
Non-finite retry/error and native slot timings; single-request accounting and admission release preserved.
Optional _json headers, retryable 503s, preparation disconnects, native timings and FIFO release.
Engine crash classification and Responses reasoning_effort only; full MockEngine HTTP contract suite passes unchanged.
